## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, signalling mixed internals; VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) falling and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) rising provide offsetting signals that support a neutral reading. HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.75%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) add a second confirmation of balanced risk.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear decreasing: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) ↓ falling indicates lower volatility. Credit conditions modestly easing: HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.75%) and LQD (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND, while bond demand remains supportive with TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-loose: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) and corporate credit ETFs HYG/LQD ABOVE TREND point to accommodative pockets, but mixed breadth keeps conditions from tilting decisively. Dollar and yield curve indicators are neutral in the input data, so no forced shift in duration posture.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech and momentum leadership but breadth mixed: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) showing strength while XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) drags. Style mixed / no clear leadership given only 6/11 sectors positive.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities firm: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +2.36%) outperform, while EM strength is notable with EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.58% | 1M: +6.07%). China weakness persists: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -6.24%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation has recovered but uneven: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.34%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +5.29%) show risk-on flows, while IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +3.65% | 1M: -16.47%) signals short-term bitcoin strength off a weak month.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Base/industrial metals constructive: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.62%) pointing to industrial demand; gold in RECOVERY with GLD (1W: +3.74% | 1M: -7.13%) reflecting safe‑haven rotation. Precious metals show short-term rebounds but month trends remain negative for silver and gold.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) with oil ETFs BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%) and USO BELOW TREND (1W: -14.94% | 1M: -23.48%) deeply negative; natural gas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.26%) is flat to slightly constructive.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +5.33%) and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) show multi-timeframe confirmation. DIVERGENCE: Energy (XLE BELOW TREND) and commodity oil ETFs (BNO/USO BELOW TREND) represent a material sector drag; several small divergences in retail/real estate are minor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to tech and momentum-oriented ETFs showing strength (XLK ABOVE TREND, SOXX ABOVE TREND) and emerging markets (EEM ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to energy and oil-linked ETFs (XLE BELOW TREND, BNO BELOW TREND). Maintain neutral stance on duration as TLT ABOVE TREND offsets pure equity bias.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology and semiconductors — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%). BEARISH: Energy — XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper (CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.62%)) and selective precious metals on rebounds (GLD RECOVERY). BEARISH: Crude/oil complex (USO BELOW TREND, BNO BELOW TREND) remains the primary downside risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ~20 as complacency threshold given VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%); monitor HYG/LQD spread for credit stress (both ABOVE TREND); track XLK/XLF relative moves for any rotation signal that would flip breadth above/below the 6/11 pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) and HYG/LQD ABOVE TREND (HYG 1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.75%; LQD 1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) offering offsetting confirmations. Tech and semiconductors are showing strength (XLK ABOVE TREND; SOXX ABOVE TREND) while energy (XLE BELOW TREND; BNO BELOW TREND) is the key divergence to monitor.
